major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Serenity
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Spend it on your lowest ally as it comes back, pooling a charge only for known incoming single-target damage and never sitting on two.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id, 5/5 sampled parses (343 casts). Table base_cd_s is 60; healing casts and Apotheosis cut the real cadence far below that.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Sanctify
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on the stacked group as raid damage lands, and do not sit on two charges.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; talent gated so zero casts is not read as a miss.

major_cooldowns.name: Halo
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it as raid damage begins so it expands and contracts through the hit, and pair every cast with Apotheosis on Archon.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not pressed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; the sampled field plays the Oracle build, hence talent gated.

major_cooldowns.name: Apotheosis
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter it holding a Holy Word: Serenity charge, then spend every global on a spell that casts or builds a Holy Word.

major_cooldowns.name: Power Infusion
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it as heavy damage lands so the haste buys you extra casts inside the window.

major_cooldowns.name: Divine Hymn
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it into raid-wide damage; it puts Guardian Spirit on you, so you can finish the channel standing in a swirl or out of line of sight.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 64843 is the cast id; 64844 is the aura twin of the same name.

major_cooldowns.name: Guardian Spirit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Put it on the tank ahead of a lethal hit for the cheat death, and self-cast it when the tanks are not using it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 47788 is the cast id; 48153 is the unobserved twin of the same name.

major_cooldowns.name: Holy Word: Chastise
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Weave it into downtime for free damage whenever nobody needs a heal.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast in 3 of 5 sampled parses; class-tree talent, so zero casts is not read as a miss.

rule.description: Spend Surge of Light on Flash Heal or Prayer of Healing
rule.action: Fire a Prayer of Healing or an instant Flash Heal while the proc is up, and hold at most two stacks.

rule.description: Keep Protective Light up with Flash Heal
rule.action: Cast Flash Heal on any ally to keep the damage reduction rolling on yourself.
